from rdflib import Graph

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

# Check Math201 enrollments
query = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?studentName (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?course; separator=", ") AS ?courses) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?count)
WHERE {
    ?student a uni:Person ;
             uni:role "Student" ;
             uni:hasName ?studentName ;
             uni:isEnrolledIn ?course .
    ?course uni:isTaughtIn uni:Mathematics_Sorbonne .
    OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate } .
    FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
}
GROUP BY ?studentName
"""
results = g.query(query)
for row in results:
    print(f"Student: {row.studentName}, Courses: {row.courses}")
print(f"Total: {len(list(g.query(query)))}")

from rdflib import Graph

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

# Verify excluded: John Smith (US only), Marie Dubois (FR but only 6 students),
# Athanasios Voulodimos (Assistant Professor), Stefan Mueller (Assistant Professor)

# Check John Smith
query = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
SELECT ?country
WHERE {
    uni:John_Smith uni:worksIn ?dept .
    ?dept a uni:Department ;
          uni:belongsTo ?university .
    ?university uni:locatedInCountry ?country .
}
"""
print("John Smith countries:", [r.country for r in g.query(query)])

# Check Marie Dubois student count
query2 = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?cnt)
WHERE {
    uni:Marie_Dubois uni:worksIn ?dept2 .
    ?course a uni:Course ;
            uni:isTaughtIn ?dept2 .
    ?student a uni:Person ;
             uni:role "Student" ;
             uni:isEnrolledIn ?course ;
             uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?enrollDate .
    OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate } .
    FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
}
"""
print("Marie Dubois student count:", list(g.query(query2))[0].cnt)

# Check Stefan Mueller student count
query3 = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?cnt)
WHERE {
    uni:Stefan_Mueller uni:worksIn ?dept2 .
    ?course a uni:Course ;
            uni:isTaughtIn ?dept2 .
    ?student a uni:Person ;
             uni:role "Student" ;
             uni:isEnrolledIn ?course ;
             uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?enrollDate .
    OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate } .
    FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
}
"""
print("Stefan Mueller student count:", list(g.query(query3))[0].cnt)
